subject.title: fix(openrouter): apply request policy to music generation requests

question: Should OpenRouter music generation honor the existing explicit `models.providers.openrouter.request.allowPrivateNetwork` trust decision instead of retaining its music-specific hard denial?
rationale: Source, docs, sibling policy, and proof support the shared-policy behavior, but repository policy requires owner confirmation when a patch changes a private-network security boundary.

options.title: Honor shared request policy
options.body: Accept the PR so headers, proxy settings, TLS policy, and explicit private-network opt-in work consistently for OpenRouter music generation.

options.title: Retain the music-specific denial
options.body: Keep private-network access disabled for this path and narrow any fix to non-network-expanding request settings, documenting why music generation is intentionally stricter.

recommendation.title: Honor shared request policy
recommendation.body: Accept the PR so headers, proxy settings, TLS policy, and explicit private-network opt-in work consistently for OpenRouter music generation.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the shared provider transport-policy boundary that governs this decision.
